title: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) Monitoring & Cephalad Decompression
plain_language_summary: Retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thickening, optic sheath diameter expansion, or intraocular pressure shift observed.
crew_instructions: Schedule 2-hour daily Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) session at -25 mmHg to redistribute cephalad fluid shift.
Perform optical coherence tomography (OCT) or portable ultrasound optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) scan within 24 hours.
Evaluate visual acuity chart and log Amsler grid distortion notes.
Review sodium intake logs and maintain dietary sodium below 3,000 mg/day.
de_escalation_criteria: Optic nerve sheath diameter stabilized, RNFL thickness stable across two consecutive scans 7 days apart.
